name: airfare-brain
description: True cost of a flight: bags, seats and fees on 29 airlines, from each airline's own pages, dated and sourced.

capabilities: True cost of a fare with bags and seats
Compare airlines once bags are added
Whole trip with car hire at the airport
defaultPrompt: I found a Ryanair return for €39. What will it cost with a 20kg bag?
Is easyJet or Wizz Air cheaper for two people with one checked bag?
How much is a cabin bag on Jet2, and what size is allowed?

positive.description: True cost of a low-cost fare with bags
positive.prompt: Using Airfare Brain: I found a Ryanair return for €39. What will it really cost with a cabin bag and a 20kg checked bag?
positive.expected_behavior: Fare plus Ryanair's published cabin-bag and 20kg-bag prices for both flights, as a range (about €107 to €231), each item with Ryanair's source page and the date checked, and a warning that the bag costs more if bought at the airport.

positive.description: Comparing two airlines for a couple
positive.prompt: Is easyJet or Wizz Air cheaper for two people sharing one checked bag, one way, if the fares are £45 and £38?
positive.expected_behavior: true_cost called once per airline with the fare and one checked bag; the two totals compared; where easyJet prices its bag per flight (not published), the answer says so instead of inventing a figure.

positive.prompt: How much more is a checked bag at the airport than online on Wizz Air?
positive.expected_behavior: Wizz Air's published online and airport prices for a checked bag, with the source link and date checked.

positive.description: Whole trip into one airport, with car hire
positive.prompt: We're flying Ryanair into Malaga for a week with one 20kg bag, fare €80. What will the flight extras and a hire car cost?
positive.expected_behavior: The flight's bag cost added to the fare, plus a typical 7-day car-hire cost at Malaga Airport from Car Rental Brain's measured figures (car only, dated), with links to both pages.

positive.prompt: Which airlines does Airfare Brain have fee data for, and when were they checked?
positive.expected_behavior: The list of airlines with IATA codes and the date each airline's fees were checked.

negative.description: Booking and payment are out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me the cheapest Ryanair flight to Malaga next Friday and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains Airfare Brain cannot search live fares, book or take payment; may offer what the extras would cost once the person has a fare.

negative.prompt: What does Emirates charge for an extra checked bag?
negative.expected_behavior: Says Emirates is not one of the airlines Airfare Brain covers (it may call list_airlines to check) and invents no figures.

negative.prompt: Find me a cheap hotel in Lisbon for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: No Airfare Brain tool is called; the assistant says the app covers flight fees only.

publication.release_notes: First release: five read-only tools over Airfare Brain's sourced, dated fee data for 29 airlines.
